notes: Roach Modbus Tool v1.3.5 - Poll: unplugging a USB serial adapter while polling no longer leaves the device stuck (Stop worked, Disconnect kept saying a request was still in progress): a hung serial call is cancelled, Disconnect always completes, and polling resumes by itself when the adapter is plugged back in. Edit device (double-click a device) has a Slave ID field for the selected ID tab. After Stop, the device list shows a connected device as Connected, like the status bar; it kept showing Online. A device that is not polling shows No response when its last request got no answer, and Online / N% ok again count only the replies since Auto Poll started. The Communication Log stays where you scrolled to read older rows and follows new rows again back at the bottom (Poll, Slave and Script). Script: a variable can have a type (int16, uint16, int32, uint32, int64, float32 or double), picked in the Type field under the step that sets it; values stored in it wrap like C (uint16 65535 + 1 = 0), and the Variables tab shows each variable's type, with Hex at the type's width. Untyped variables work as before. The first change to a step after a run is no longer lost. Stop clears the PASS / FAIL marks; they used to show the results of the last finished loop.
